falsePositives.obligation: Contain and control security incidents to prevent further unauthorized access to or use of customer information, and recover from them.
falsePositives.rationale: Section 248.30(a)(3)(ii) requires incident procedures to contain and control incidents to prevent further unauthorized access to customer information. The incident intake handler only inserts a row and logs it, leaving a TODO instead of any action. A repository-wide search for containment terms (revoke, disable_account, rotate_key, quarantine, kill_switch, isolate) matched no files, so the containment control appears absent.
